copy.tagline: 管理 Kubernetes 集群部署、回滚与故障排查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你负责 Kubernetes 集群的运维与故障处理
copy.tagline_en: Manage Kubernetes cluster deployments, rollbacks, and troubleshooting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle Kubernetes cluster operations and deployments

howto.what: 当处理 Kubernetes 部署、运维或排障时，Claude 会先核对集群和工具版本，再按生产规范设计最小变更，输出 YAML/Helm/Kustomize 配置及验证、回滚命令，并记录决策依据。
howto.when: 当你要求进行 Kubernetes 部署、编写或修改 Helm/Kustomize 清单、排查集群问题等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个服务生成 deployment 清单，带上资源限制、探针和安全上下文。
say.note: 会生成符合生产规范的 Deployment 清单。

say.text: 用 Helm 部署前先跑 lint 和 template 校验，确认通过再执行。
say.note: 会先执行校验，全部通过后再给出部署步骤。

say.text: 我的 pod 在 CrashLoopBackOff，帮我看日志和事件找原因。
say.note: 会检查集群事件与日志，给出排障结论和修复建议。

howto.what_en: For Kubernetes work, Claude verifies cluster/tool versions, designs minimal safe changes, and outputs YAML/Helm/Kustomize with validation, rollback commands, and decision traces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request Kubernetes deployment, Helm/Kustomize manifests, or cluster troubleshooting, among similar operations.

say_en.text: Create a deployment manifest with resource limits, probes, and security context.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a production-ready Deployment manifest.

say_en.text: Before deploying with Helm, run lint and template validation first.
say_en.note: Claude will run checks first, then propose a rollout plan.

say_en.text: My pod is crash-looping; inspect logs and events to find the cause.
say_en.note: Claude will review cluster evidence and suggest fixes.
